model_adjust.note: model with '-' and '/' replaced by ' ' (regex substitution, not a simple concat), e.g. model='SCF862/02' -> model_adjust='SCF862 02'

sku_type_complete.note: Verified live 2026-09-24: 'Philips Mixer HR1559/50', 'Okayama Blender OK-335', 'Cosmos Hand Mixer CM-1679'. category is a dict column (Mixer, Blender, Hand Mixer, Chopper, Blender & Chopper, Food Processor...). Region suffixes (/10 /40 /50) are separate identities when siblings already have them.

keywords.note: keyword_typo prefixed only when non-empty; skip cleanly (no leading space) when keyword_typo is ''/NULL. Legacy rows show a leading space artifact from a null keyword_typo still consuming its separator -- new rows should not reproduce that.
